backupUrl: Add November Maintenance Addition to the previous

During our review, we identified a few files that were flagged as suspicious during security scans. After a thorough review, all genuinely injected and unsafe files were removed from the website. Based on the file creation date it's clear the site was compromised on previous hosting. We removed compromised plugins and files while keeping the website functionality as is.

At this point, the website has been fully secured, all vulnerabilities have been addressed, and the site is now safe and functioning normally.
